title: Selected pickup and direction: r35 gate corrections
acceptance_criteria: Selected exact eligible targets use current range and block LOS, not a current aim-ray intersection; automatic selection retains ray and below-floor clipping behavior.
Normal selected jug pickup after lateral motion succeeds; wall denial preserves the original entity and empty hand.
Canonical mouse healthy, critical and recovered look intents execute on distinct ticks and have matching applied-sequence snapshots; critical facing stays unchanged and recovery restores facing.
Idle-direction fixture waits for all actual spawn positions to be entity-ticking without weakening its movement assertions or extending its 70-tick test timeout.
